rows.Evidence: `ChainFollower` holds only family, challenge, blocks, txs, spends (`sr:sidestr-agent/src/hitch/follow.rs:121-127`); `new` stores no genesis hash (`:133-141`); `plan` compares hashes from index position 0 (`:198-203`); `apply` checks only the index hash and link above height 0 (`:276-294`)
`host` gated `all(feature = "cli", unix)`, `store` gated `unix` only (`sr:sidestr-agent/src/hitch/mod.rs:34-37`)

rows.Finding: B3 clients and admission inside core
rows.Evidence: `rpc = ["std", "dep:ureq"]` (`sr:sidestr-core/Cargo.toml:38`); `pub mod rpc` under `cfg(feature = "rpc")` (`sr:sidestr-core/src/parent.rs:774-775`); `State::submit` in core (`sr:sidestr-core/src/state.rs:636`); ADR still says "Network clients and producer policy remain outside both" (`sr:docs/adr/ADR-0002-keep-optional-execution-and-services-behind-crate-boundaries.md:37`)

The CI step is still labelled "sidestr-core alone, no std" (`sr:.github/workflows/ci.yml:85-88`), and there is no `no_std` attribute (`sr:sidestr-core/src/lib.rs:298-307`). The crate doc says "The crate is not `no_std`" (`:165`). That line is unchanged since `9c6de86c` because only the ledger changed, so the CI label contradicts it. Header has the real conditional attribute (`sr:sidestr-header/src/lib.rs:144`).

ADR still says "seven public crates" (`sr:docs/adr/ADR-0002-…:38`). Eight manifests set `publish = true` (e.g. `sr:sidestr-core/Cargo.toml:15`); `sidestr-bridge-liquid`, `sidestr-evm` and `sidestr-reserve` set `publish = false` (e.g. `sr:sidestr-evm/Cargo.toml:16`). The agentbox README says the txbt4 table "ships `enabled = false`" (`ab:config/sidechain/README.md:188`), but it is `enabled = true` (`ab:agentbox.toml:1975`). VisionClaw N-10 still says "Hitch has no host" (`vc:docs/TODO-unified.md:103`).

Each withdrawal is checked with `outputs.iter().any(...)`, and no output is consumed (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/state.rs:510-515`). The allowance sums every withdrawal (`:73-77`) and feeds `coinbase_allowance` (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/rule.rs:107-109`), then the core upper bound (`sr:sidestr-core/src/rules.rs:737-756`). Reference `evm.mjs` parity is not checkable at these pins.

rows.Finding: E2 code bytes not checked against hash
rows.Evidence: `root` commits `acct.code_hash` (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/world.rs:110-121`). Execution reads `code.get(&a.code_hash)` without rehashing (`:184-203`). `restore` checks version, config and `world.root() == block.root` only (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/state.rs:305-328`). `keccak` appears in `world.rs` only in docs and tests (`:36,109,217-228`).
Time is required to exist, but its value is not checked (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/state.rs:329-333`). Receipts and blocks are copied unverified (`:340-346`).

rows.Finding: E4 selected height keeps later history
rows.Evidence: `self.blocks = snapshot.blocks.clone()` and all receipts are copied regardless of `height` (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/state.rs:335-346`). The accessors serve them (`:272-285`).
Each verdict is inserted unconditionally (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/state.rs:541`). `commit` clears `pending` but not `verdicts` (`:565-566`).

`disable_block_gas_limit = true` (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/exec.rs:170`), documented at `sr:sidestr-evm/src/config.rs:23-25`. KZG aborts (`exec.rs:77-78`). `block_hash` returns zero (`world.rs:209-210`). Chainless legacy transactions are accepted (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/tx.rs:48-54`). A published profile document is not present in what was read.

rows.Finding: F1 channel ID ignores output index
rows.Evidence: `from_txid` takes the first 16 hex characters of the txid (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/wire.rs:37-40`); `propose` uses only `funding.txid` (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/opening.rs:210`); the host drops a repeat ID in `on_open` and `on_ready` (`sr:sidestr-agent/src/hitch/host.rs:1329-1331,1482-1484`)

Buffered before the proof, state and signature checks (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/machine.rs:833-836` before `:843-850`). The buffer is snapshotted (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/snapshot.rs:155,217`). `take_buffered_update` says to replay it through `receive_update` (`machine.rs:1049-1056`). No source statement records the host obligation beyond that.

The behaviour is unchanged: the fallback arm restores `previous_status`, which can be `Open` (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/chain.rs:357-358`). The remaining acceptance is host reorganisation (block replacement, duplicates, persisted recovery), which is runtime. The rustdoc at `:335-337` still claims "never goes back to `open`" (SIDESTR-F2).

rows.Finding: F4 oracle participation for revocation and wire
rows.Evidence: The Hitch transaction oracle returns early without `HITCH` and the related variables (`sr:sidestr-hitch/tests/oracle.rs:62-66`). So do the wire oracle (`sr:sidestr-hitch/tests/wire_oracle.rs:186-188`) and the reference half of the chain test (`sr:sidestr-hitch/tests/chain_consensus.rs:416-418`). The revocation construction is unchanged (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/lib.rs:740-791`). JavaScript parity is not checkable.

rows.Finding: H1/H3 witness not checked on restore
rows.Evidence: Close and claim are checked by `compute_txid() != txid` only (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/snapshot.rs:341-354`). The module doc still says "checked in full on restore" (`:1`).

Present secrets are checked for consistency only (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/snapshot.rs:274-278`). `revoked` is computed from the current map (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/protocol/chain.rs:242`). The same-txid fast path returns the stored `kind` without reclassifying (`:189-194`).

`InvoiceRecord` has no expiry (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/route.rs:98-106`). The payee lookup passes `i.record` unfiltered (`sr:sidestr-agent/src/hitch/host.rs:1677-1682`). The payer checks `inv.x < unix_now()` (`:1883-1885`).

rows.Finding: H5 host is not a hub
rows.Evidence: `Router::new(false, 0)` (`sr:sidestr-agent/src/hitch/host.rs:680`). `Forward` maps to `Ok(())` (`:1752`). The kernel records a forward before returning (`sr:sidestr-hitch/src/route.rs:379-391`) and offers `with_forwards` (`:247-253`).

`upstream()` returns `None` when `bin/siding.mjs` is absent (`sr:sidestr-round/tests/support/interop.rs:23-26,34-39`). Pegtweak returns `None` when variables or `lib/pegtweak.mjs` are absent (`sr:sidestr-core/tests/pegtweak.rs:406-414`). No strict mode was found.

ADR says "all four reference repositories" (`sr:docs/adr/ADR-0001-reference-oracle-is-the-compatibility-contract.md:27`), and its trigger omits Reef and teller (`:12`). The workflow pins six (`sr:.github/workflows/ci.yml:17-30`), with checkouts at `:108-143`.
`runs-on: ubuntu-latest` (`ci.yml:35,101`), `toolchain: stable` (`:42,157`), `node-version: 22` (`:152`). The Cargo commands have no `--locked` (`:53,56,62,65,87-88,97,208`).
The `oracle` job has no `needs` edge (`ci.yml:99-102`; `git grep needs:` is empty). Branch protection and publication credentials are external state and could not be checked.

rows.Finding: O1 producer evicts on block-global failure
rows.Evidence: The core fallback evicts any transaction whose candidate verdict fails (`sr:sidestr-core/src/state.rs:882-895`). The composed producer does the same (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/rule.rs:364-371`). Exact bytes are remembered (`sr:sidestr-core/src/state.rs:762-770`) and refused on resubmission (`:646-651`).

Each rule only replaces the same hash and pushes: assets `sr:sidestr-core/src/assets.rs:535-536`, pool `sr:sidestr-core/src/pool.rs:316-317`, markets `sr:sidestr-core/src/markets.rs:434-435`. The only other mutation is `std::mem::take` in `applied` (`assets.rs:546`, `pool.rs:324`, `markets.rs:445`), from `git grep -n pending` over the three files.

context.Evidence: Holder-side `AssetView` reading is documented (`sr:sidestr-core/src/assets.rs:18-25`). No rules gives `Rules::default()` (`sr:sidestr-evm/src/rule.rs:425-427`). Diagram SR-02 line 69 states this distinction. The consumer badge criterion is not checkable.

The split and merge arms check no status (`sr:sidestr-core/src/markets.rs:260-287`). Unresolved refund requires combined burns of at least twice the amount and sets `Refunding` (`:306-320`). Diagram SR-02 lines 78-90 match.

findings.consequence: No remediation has landed for any of the 25 open rows (26 IDs), including the security-relevant B1, E1, E2, H1/H3 and H2. Every acceptance criterion in the six reports is still unmet. The pin's last commit is a dream-cycle ledger row marked REJECT.

The rustdoc on `un_spend` promises the channel "never goes back to `open`", but the code restores `Open`. Integrators reading the API docs get the same wrong invariant that the 1 November report removed from the diagram.
The module doc says snapshots are "checked in full on restore", but witnesses are not checked (H1/H3).
The crate doc and the CI label disagree inside one repository. This mismatch already existed at `9c6de86c` and is not a partial fix. Renaming the CI step closes B4's documentation half.
The agentbox operator README says the txbt4 table ships disabled, but the shipped config enables it. This is B5's consumer half, unchanged at the agentbox pin.
VisionClaw N-10 still says "Hitch has no host" while the host module exists. The estate adoption tracker understates the implementation and does not record B1's identity gap.
